name: n8n-as-code
description: Codex plugin for n8n-as-code. Adds the n8n-architect skill, which drives the n8nac CLI to create, edit, validate, and sync n8n workflows as TypeScript files in your repository.

interface.longDescription:
n8n-as-code lets Codex create, edit, validate, and sync n8n workflows as TypeScript files kept in your repository.

The n8n-architect skill drives the open-source n8nac command-line tool: it connects the workspace to your own n8n instance with an API key you provide, pulls existing workflows into local .workflow.ts files, looks up exact node schemas and parameters in a bundled knowledge base of n8n nodes, validates changes before anything is sent, and pushes workflows back to n8n only when you ask.

Who it is for: developers and automation builders who already run n8n (cloud or self-hosted) and want their workflows reviewed, versioned, and edited like code.

Limitations: the skill runs commands in a local shell, so it needs Codex (or another environment with a shell) and Node.js 20 or later. It works only with n8n instances you can reach and have an API key for. It does not host n8n. Your n8n API key is kept in the local n8n-as-code secret store on your machine, outside the workspace, and is never sent to the project author.
capabilities: Create and edit n8n workflows as TypeScript
Look up n8n node schemas and parameters
Pull and push workflows to your n8n instance
defaultPrompt: Set up n8n-as-code in this repository and connect it to my n8n instance.
Create an n8n workflow that posts new GitHub issues to a Slack channel.
Pull my n8n workflows and fix the validation errors in the failing one.

publication.release_notes: First release in the plugin directory: the n8n-architect skill for authoring, validating, and syncing n8n workflows with the n8nac CLI.
